svg.text: I test 161 kV transformers by day and write the
software the plant runs on by night. Dispatch, testing,
quality and hardware paperwork used to live in
spreadsheets and phone calls. Now they are buttons.
“Engineering isn't just circuits and code. It's building things that make a real difference.”
